**Before opening this request**

Please check the [documentation](https://github.com/ArnaudBuchholz/ui5-test-runner/tree/main/docs#-documentation) and the [existing options](https://github.com/ArnaudBuchholz/ui5-test-runner/blob/main/docs/options.md) — the feature you need may already exist.

**Is your feature request related to a problem? Please describe.**

A clear and concise description of the problem. Example: "I can't do X when running against Y because..."

**Describe the solution you'd like**

A clear and concise description of what you want to happen, including any new CLI options or configuration keys if applicable.

**Describe alternatives you've considered**

Any alternative solutions or workarounds you've already tried.

**Additional context**

Any other context, screenshots, or examples that help illustrate the request.
